method: Each row groups successful measured turns from one Object and one label. Values preserve epoch/repeat order. Take medians within rows, then across Objects for target medians; divide Yielded by pi. Pair labels on target/history/provider/state/Object for treatment differences. Fresh-isolate comparisons require every planned turn in all four epochs to be eligible; consult nonOkSampleDetails in runs.json and exclude incomplete Objects. No warmup timing is included. Null CPU or admission is missing, not zero. SQL reads are cumulative through the named point and are not physical page faults. Padding active-byte values describe the last preparation and may be reused for repeated labels; postTurnDatabaseBytes gives current size after each turn.
